questions.question: If n(A x B) = 6 and A = {1, 3}, then n(B) is:
questions.questionTa: n(A x B) = 6 மற்றும் A = {1, 3} எனில், n(B) இன் மதிப்பு:
questions.explanation: Since n(A x B) = n(A) x n(B), 6 = 2 x n(B), so n(B) = 3. / n(A x B) = n(A) x n(B) என்பதால், 6 = 2 x n(B), ஆகவே n(B) = 3.
